gate: G7 same-config medians reproducible across repeats
defects_fixed: v1.4: a failed group previously set pass=false, but a later passing group overwrote it back to true; overall result is now initialised PASS and only ever assigned false
v1.5: comparison was adjacent-only; now EVERY repeat is compared with EVERY other repeat in its group (all-pairs max-spread)
v1.5: statistics must now exist, be computed, carry >=10 samples and a finite median; profiler/telemetry records (which may carry an informational benchmark_id) are never benchmark evidence
grouping: by serialized configuration block; independence requires distinct record_id, NOT a shared experiment_id; only kind benchmark|baseline and status PASSED form groups
zero_semantics: both zero -> 0 percent; exactly one zero -> 100 percent
cases_covered: all groups pass -> pass
first group fails, later group passes -> fail (both sort orders)
first group passes, later group fails -> fail
single-run group beside a passing repeated group -> fail
missing repeat -> fail
duplicate-only repeat (shared record_id) -> fail
three repeats 100/90/80 (adjacent <=15 percent, endpoints 20 percent) -> fail (all-pairs)
three repeats all pairwise within tolerance (max 14 percent) -> pass
four repeats with one outlier -> fail
reordering the same records does not change the verdict
exact 15 percent timing boundary -> pass
just above 15 percent (16 percent) -> fail
exact 20 percent bandwidth boundary -> pass
just above 20 percent (21 percent) -> fail
18 percent on a timing benchmark -> fail
both zero -> pass; one zero -> fail
non-finite median (inf / nan) -> fail
missing statistics on one run -> fail
computed=false with non-empty samples -> fail
computed=true with empty samples -> fail
computed=true with <10 samples -> fail
PASSED telemetry record carrying benchmark_id is ignored -> pass
grouping by configuration (E1+E5) -> pass
grouping by configuration (two same-experiment repeats) -> pass
multiple groups with mixed outcomes -> fail
